documents.en/lighthouse.md:
# lighthouse

The lighthouse fog log stays in the orange box beside the radio.
documents.en/lighthouse-related.md:
# Related note

The lighthouse visitor book is kept under the stairs.
documents.en/book-cart.md:
# book-cart

The library's book cart wheels are serviced each April.
documents.en/book-cart-related.md:
# Related note

The library desk drawers are serviced in August.
documents.en/resin.md:
# resin

The casting workshop waits six hours before opening the resin mould.
documents.en/resin-related.md:
# Related note

The casting workshop washes the reusable mould every Friday.
documents.en/aquarium.md:
# aquarium

The aquarium swaps the feeding shift with the night keeper when the pier closes.
documents.en/aquarium-related.md:
# Related note

The aquarium night keeper also records water temperature.
documents.en/tapestry.md:
# tapestry

The tapestry exhibition uses a grey curtain to block midday sunlight.
documents.en/tapestry-related.md:
# Related note

The tapestry exhibition uses a green rope to guide visitors.
documents.en/bread.md:
# bread

The bakery puts unsold rye loaves on the bottom shelf for donation.
documents.en/bread-related.md:
# Related note

The bakery puts fresh wheat rolls on the top shelf.
documents.en/clock.md:
# clock

The clock museum closes its bell exhibit after a hearing alarm.
documents.en/clock-related.md:
# Related note

The clock museum opens its pendulum exhibit every morning.
documents.en/waterwheel.md:
# waterwheel

The mill opens the bypass gate before inspecting the waterwheel.
documents.en/waterwheel-related.md:
# Related note

The mill paints its main gate every winter.
documents.zh/陶印.md:
# 陶印

陶艺室的印坯必须放在通风架上晾两天。
documents.zh/陶印-related.md:
# Related note

陶艺室的木制印章每月用干布清理。
documents.zh/岩洞.md:
# 岩洞

岩洞步道在雨量超过二十毫米时关闭。
documents.zh/岩洞-related.md:
# Related note

岩洞售票窗在周二下午关闭。
documents.zh/织线.md:
# 织线

修复员用米白色棉线缝补织物背面。
documents.zh/织线-related.md:
# Related note

陈列员用灰色绳索划出参观路线。
documents.zh/茶炉.md:
# 茶炉

值班人用蓝色木牌标记已经熄火的茶炉。
documents.zh/茶炉-related.md:
# Related note

会议室用绿色纸条标记已清洁的桌面。
documents.zh/口琴.md:
# 口琴

初学者的口琴练习集中在东边的小教室。
documents.zh/口琴-related.md:
# Related note

口琴维修工具放在西边的柜子里。
documents.zh/芦苇.md:
# 芦苇

研究员每隔三天记录一次芦苇样地水位。
documents.zh/芦苇-related.md:
# Related note

研究员每周记录一次芦苇样地的鸟类。
documents.zh/火车.md:
# 火车

观景火车遇到大风时只开到松林站。
documents.zh/火车-related.md:
# Related note

观景火车平日会停在湖边站拍照。
documents.zh/灯笼.md:
# 灯笼

制作灯笼时，先用细竹条固定底框，再包纸。
documents.zh/灯笼-related.md:
# Related note

灯笼游行结束后，先把纸罩取下。
documents.mixed/binder.md:
# binder

Binder C 的交接页由夜班主管签字。
documents.mixed/binder-related.md:
# Related note

Binder C 的借用日期由前台填写。
documents.mixed/loom-7.md:
# loom-7

Loom 7 的经纱断裂时，把脚踏杆锁在抬起位置。
documents.mixed/loom-7-related.md:
# Related note

Loom 7 空闲时把线轴放在右侧。
documents.mixed/aurora.md:
# aurora

Aurora tray 的冷藏贴纸到周五傍晚作废。
documents.mixed/aurora-related.md:
# Related note

Aurora tray 的搬运标签上写着手推车号。
documents.mixed/cedar.md:
# cedar

Cedar Pass 关闭时，包裹集中到河边的临时收件站。
documents.mixed/cedar-related.md:
# Related note

Cedar Pass 的行人绕道从果园经过。
documents.mixed/sable.md:
# sable

Sable kit 的备用螺丝用紫色袋子装。
documents.mixed/sable-related.md:
# Related note

Sable kit 的损坏螺丝放在红色罐子里。
documents.mixed/echo.md:
# echo

Echo dock 在暴雨期间暂停非紧急装卸。
documents.mixed/echo-related.md:
# Related note

Echo dock 常规装卸在工作日进行。
documents.mixed/iris.md:
# iris

Iris map 所有破损的地标页交给制图员重画。
documents.mixed/iris-related.md:
# Related note

Iris map 原件由资料管理员保存。
documents.mixed/opal.md:
# opal

Opal rack 的湿布下班前要挂到有通风孔的支架上。
documents.mixed/opal-related.md:
# Related note

Opal rack 干布摆放在抽屉里面。
